Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 22-Nov-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  SEVENTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  Cloud Computing [NPT_4120]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                     Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                Evaluate how the NIST definition of cloud computing supports agility, cost efficiency, and user self-   (5)  
  service in modern IT ecosystems.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Evaluate the suitability of hybrid cloud deployment for organizations that need both high security      (3)  
  and flexible scalability.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  C)           Explain how organizations can integrate IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS models to build a complete cloud-          (2)  
  based solution.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
2)                Examine how continuous monitoring and automated tools improve SLA compliance in cloud service (5)  
  management.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Compare how utility-based pricing and subscription-based pricing influence cost transparency for        (3)  
  cloud consumers.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  C)           Explain how performance bottlenecks and tenant isolation issues can affect the efficiency of multi-     (2)  
  tenant cloud platforms.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3)                Examine the consequences of poor data lifecycle management on data security and compliance              (5)  
  within cloud storage systems.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Apply the concept of data governance to describe how organizations ensure compliance when               (3)  
  storing data across different countries.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  
  Page #1

C)                Identify which type of storage block, file, or object would be most suitable for hosting large            (2)  
  multimedia files and justify your choice.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
4)                        Evaluate how dynamic resource allocation supports scalability and service continuity in cloud             (5)  
  computing environments.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)                Assess how elastic scaling and intelligent load balancing contribute to handling fluctuating              (3)  
  workloads in cloud applications.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  C)                Apply monitoring and metering techniques to explain how cloud providers reduce operational costs          (2)  
  and power usage.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
5)                        Evaluate the major security issues and challenges in cloud computing and discuss how they                 (5)  
  influence trust and data protection across different cloud models.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)                Explain with examples how cryptography, encryption, and key management are applied to protect             (3)  
  data in cloud computing environments.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  C)                Examine how Identity and Access Management (IAM) enhances security by controlling user                    (2)  
  authentication and authorization in cloud systems.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"
